verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents teams: you can create a team, invite members, and assign them roles (docs-50, docs-60), with team credit funded by transferring personal credits (docs-61). Its API-keys docs and CLI support scoped keys limited to the permissions a workload needs, via `vastai create api-key` (docs-5, docs-19, docs-24). missing for 10: detail on what each role can and cannot do, explicit spend limits or budget controls per member or key, independent or hands-on corroboration.
